## Summary

<!-- Short and to the point: the goal of this change, and how it reaches it. Write for a reader who knows nothing about it yet; link documents where they help, but do not assume the reader has read them. -->
<!-- Then the issue or RFC section it answers, e.g. "Closes #123" or "RFC 0001, Where we want your advice, point 2". A pull request without one is closed unless it is a typo fix. -->

## How it is implemented

<!-- The approaches you took, and why where it is not obvious. Then the affected packages or components, e.g. "Affected: crates/core, crates/chat, docs". No list of files: the diff shows those. -->

## How it was tested

<!-- Which kinds of tests are new (unit, integration, end to end, a manual check) and what each proves, and which existing tests changed and why. Only what you actually ran. No command transcripts or logs: CI shows those. -->

## Change fragment

<!-- The fragment's path, e.g. changes/add-sync-retry.md (see changes/README.md). Or write "Not product-changing:" and the reason, e.g. "Not product-changing: docs only." -->

## Security considerations

<!-- If this touches sync, the relay, auth, storage or the on-disk format: what could go wrong for a user's data or keys, and why it does not. Otherwise write "Not applicable." -->

## Authorship

<!-- Check exactly one box. Disclosure is required, see .github/AI_POLICY.md. -->

- [ ] Human: a person wrote this change.
- [ ] Agent under close human direction: an agent wrote it while a person steered it step by step.
- [ ] Agent with human review: an agent wrote it on its own; a person reviewed all of it before this pull request was opened.
- [ ] Agent, checked against a decided design: an agent implemented an RFC the owner has decided; the factory's pm checked it against that RFC and the gates, and no person reviewed every line before the merge (see .github/AI_POLICY.md).
- [ ] Agent, beta release notes: an agent curated a beta's release notes from the change fragments; the factory's pm checked them, and no person reviewed them before the merge (see .github/AI_POLICY.md).
- [ ] Agent, carries out a decision: an agent changed documentation only to record a decision the owner made or to follow merged RFC text; the factory's pm checked every change against its source, and no person reviewed it before the merge (see .github/AI_POLICY.md).
- [ ] Agent, tooling: an agent changed only developer and agent tooling, no gate, workflow, product code or policy; the factory's pm checked that, and no person reviewed it before the merge (see .github/AI_POLICY.md).
